source.title: Black Hole Black Boxes: Numerical Black Hole Metrics via AInstein Neural Networks

paraphrase: The paper extends the AInstein PINN architecture to Lorentzian signature and validates it by recovering the maximally extended Schwarzschild geometry, using losses encoding the vacuum Einstein equation, a quadratic Weyl scalar constraint, and SO(3) symmetry.
limitations: Not yet independently reproduced by ScienceBro.
Author-side validation uses the upstream training/evaluation path.

source.title: Black Hole Black Boxes: Numerical Black Hole Metrics via AInstein Neural Networks

paraphrase: Using a Petrov speciality index, a horizon curvature anchor, and a trapped-surface constraint, the authors report finding potentially novel algebraically general (Petrov type I) Lorentzian Einstein metrics with a genuinely trapped interior.
limitations: Authors themselves qualify the result as 'potentially novel'.
Numerical residuals may not establish a globally valid geometry.
Not yet independently reproduced by ScienceBro.
